text: What if you could see sound for one day?
Some people think the world would turn into a light show.
But sound is really a wave of pressure, squeezing through the air.
So when a dog barks, a red wave bursts out and passes right through the wall.
Your fridge sits inside a green glow, humming all day long.
And a thunderclap splits the whole sky into giant rings.
But the strangest part is silence, because silence looks like darkness.
What sound would you want to see first?
